value.rationale: Periodic non-positional resetting is already proposed as a shape-sorting mechanism in Cleuren–Eichhorn 2026, which identifies enhanced diffusion as an open useful control. The theorem gives a natural sharp design target: a unique reset period at which an anisotropic coupled colloid spreads isotropically, and an experimentally diagnostic 90-degree diffusion-axis reversal. The trace ordering and drift–dispersion identity quantify fluctuations against sorting drift across every SPD mobility tensor, not a numerical one-off.
